When a real risk of collision exists, COLREG (the International Regulations for Preventing Collisions at Sea) governs which vessel gives way and how -- satisfy that constraint first, then resume progress toward the goal. TCPA=0 does NOT always mean a collision is imminent -- it also occurs when the vessels are already moving apart (closest point already passed); the situation report says so explicitly when that's the case. Otherwise it gives you the exact action ("turn_left"/"turn_right") and degrees to use -- copy those values directly into your answer, don't recompute them and don't substitute a different number from elsewhere in the report.
